faqs.q: How does Techno Horizon handle institutional data security and compliance?
faqs.a: Our architecture practices enforce strict role-based access control (RBAC), end-to-end data encryption in transit and at rest, automated vulnerability scanning, and adherence to public data protection standards.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with existing departmental databases and legacy portals?
faqs.a: Yes. Our systems integration framework connects with legacy RDBMS, proprietary public sector registries, payment gateways, and authentication services using secure REST and SOAP endpoints.

faqs.q: Do you provide pricing packages or software subscription tiers?
faqs.a: No. Techno Horizon delivers bespoke enterprise software engineered to exact institutional specifications under customized scopes of work and institutional procurement contracts.
